structured_output.analysis:
Only one recipe has been measured so far: iso_3.15, with KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 average bits. That leaves almost no room under the 3.1484-bit budget. The knapsack already picked the lowest-KL method at each layer's bit level. For example, layer 27 up_proj uses gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] rather than rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00774 [E8972491007e7]. So swapping methods at the same bit level gains nothing. The remaining options are settings that cost no bits and moves that trade bits between layers. The prediction undershoots the measured KL (0.398 vs 0.436), so the predictions are only a rough guide.
Upgrading one bit costs about 3.15M bits per MLP layer. The best gains per bit are:
- 14.down_proj, rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3: 0.00633 to 0.00181 [E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645].
- 27.up_proj, gptq_int3 to gptq_int4: 0.00572 to 0.00217 [Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc].
- 18.gate_proj, rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3.
To pay for these, I propose a larger group size (weight.group_size=256) for the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers, which roughly halves their scale overhead. My bit estimate for this could be off, so this proposal may be refused for going over budget. Separately, turning on act_order costs no bits and normally reduces GPTQ error.

proposals.name: actorder_all
proposals.rationale: No layer methods change and no bits are added; only act_order=true is set for every GPTQ variant. This targets the GPTQ layers where the loss is concentrated, e.g. 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]. Base KL is 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: gs256_rht3_fund_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 for rht_gptq_int3 pays for three upgrades. 14.down_proj moves from rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 [E90bd4b2f3645]. 27.up_proj moves from gptq_int3 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to gptq_int4 0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc]. 18.gate_proj leaves rht_gptq_int2, which has 0.00497 above floor [Eb1dd74cd6447]. Base KL is 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: gs256_rht3_upgrades_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same upgrades as the previous proposal, which uses weight.group_size=256 for rht_gptq_int3: 14.down_proj 0.00633 to 0.00181 [E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645] and 27.up_proj 0.00572 to 0.00217 [Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc]. Here act_order=true is added on top to offset the extra error from the larger group size. Base KL is 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].
